Maya (Design): quick design review — proposal to add hover preview + keyboard shortcuts for the capacity controls (min/max, burst, pool selector). dropping a short prototype gif and thoughts. :eyes: Arjun (PM): nice — can the preview show the immediate cost delta and expected latency impact? customers ask for both when they tweak SLOs. Priya (Frontend): can do a cheap live calc client-side for delta, but need the exact unit math. @Arjun can you confirm whether burst pricing is per-minute or per-second in the billing model? Arjun (PM): burst billed per-minute for Dedicated; for Hosted it's amortized per-token but we can show an approximation. show both: "estimated cost (dedicated)" and "approx. hosted token cost". keep it low-fi. Maya (Design): thinking microcopy: "Preview: est. +$3.50 /hr, latency ± 40ms" — or maybe "est. cost impact". open to wording. Leo (A11y): two accessibility notes: 1) hover-only previews break keyboard users — must be visible on focus and exposed via screenreader (aria-live). 2) contrast for the preview chip is low on dark theme (WCAG AA fail). Priya (Frontend): good catch. aria-live snippet I can add:```html
Estimated change: +$3.50 /hr, latency +40ms
```Will make it tabbable and show on focus. Maya (Design): keyboard shortcuts: idea is `k`/`j` for step up/down when the control has focus, and `shift` + `k`/`j` for 10x steps. also an inline hint: small "?" help tooltip on first use. Thoughts? Sam (Infra): love shortcuts but watch accidental presses when typing in other inputs. they must only be active when the capacity panel has focus (or when a global shortcuts modal is open). Priya (Frontend): yep — scope shortcuts to the control container with `keydown` + `event.target.closest('.capacity-panel')`. will include an off switch in settings. Arjun (PM): copy tweak: replace "Burst" with "Burst (temporary capacity)"? feels clearer for non-technical PMs. keep label short; maybe a tooltip explains duration and billing. Maya (Design): leaning toward "Burst (temp)" — shorter. tooltip copy: "Temporary capacity to handle spikes. Billed while active." Leo (A11y): tooltip accessible pattern: use `aria-describedby` and ensure it's reachable by keyboard. also ensure tooltip has role="dialog" or role="tooltip" depending on interaction. contrast again on the tooltip bg/text. Priya (Frontend): will add keyboard focus styles, visible outline, and ensure the tooltip is read by SR when opened. Maya (Design): visual: preview chip placed to the right of the slider thumb on hover/focus. if screen width < 480px show a stacked inline row under the slider. Arjun (PM): can we show a mini-sparkline of recent latency to indicate how close we are to SLO? low fidelity is fine. Maya (Design): small sparkline yes — 32x12 px. show with an icon color that follows status (green/orange/red) — but we need a text fallback for colorblind users. Leo (A11y): perf sparkline accessible: include an offscreen text like "latency: 72ms (target 50ms)" and never rely on color alone. Priya (Frontend): timeline: prototype -> dev spike -> accessibility pass. I can prototype interactions this week, then Sam's team can review infra impacts on burst toggles. Sam (Infra): note for infra: when burst toggles flip quickly we should debounce API calls and prefer optimistic UI with a rollback on error. also ensure the preview calc uses cached billing rates, don't call pricing API on every hover. Maya (Design): microcopy candidates for the preview header: ["Estimated impact", "Quick estimate", "Preview: cost & latency"]. prefer short. Arjun (PM): pick "Estimated impact". consistent with other console language. Maya (Design): uploaded prototype gif and a11y checklist to the Figma thread: https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/capacity-hover-proto — feedback welcome. Priya (Frontend): will post a PR with prototype branch link when ready. Leo (A11y): will run a quick axe + keyboard walkthrough once the prototype is live. deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: capacity-preview-proto -> staging at 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC :package: Maya (Design): thanks all — will iterate on copy and push updated screens by EOD. :sparkles:
